leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a TypeScript interface to specify the structure of accordion item data with required properties.
Construct a functional React component with TypeScript to serve as the main accordion container.
Implement useState hook to manage which accordion item is currently expanded.
Apply array iteration to map through accordion items and render individual accordion sections.
Utilize conditional rendering to display different content based on the expanded state of each item.
Handle click events to toggle the expanded state of accordion items when headers are clicked.
Control CSS classes dynamically to apply visual styles that indicate expanded or collapsed states.
Access and display data properties from the accordion items within the rendered JSX structure.
Modify state management logic to ensure only one accordion item can be expanded at a time.
Return structured JSX with proper semantic HTML elements for accessibility and styling.
Assign unique identifiers or indices to accordion items for reliable state tracking during toggles.
Invoke the main accordion component with sample data to test the complete functionality.
